name: team_task_list
description: List shared tasks, including readiness, owner, revision, blockers, and write-scope warnings. Deleted tasks are excluded; results are paged.

owner.description: Optional owner agent name filter; cannot be combined with unowned.

unowned.description: Filter tasks by whether they have no owner; cannot be combined with owner.

limit.description: Number of rows, 1 through 100. Defaults to 50.

prompt: Team shared task board: create, read, list, and compare-and-set tasks across the subagent tree. Claim a ready task with its current revision, do the work, then complete it. Dependencies gate claims; write scopes are advisory, not a lock.
